rationale: Mismatched paper text: the bibliographic record S573 specifies Shields et al. (2021), 'Community management does not equate to participation: fostering community participation in rural water supplies,' Journal of Water, Sanitation and Hygiene for Development 11(6):937-947 (DOI: 10.2166/washdev.2021.089), whereas the retrieved 215-page PDF is Erick Oniango Ananga's 2015 University of South Florida PhD dissertation on SANA-sponsored urban water schemes in Kisumu, Kenya. Following strict instruction 2 for mismatched papers, paper_read is marked 'not accessible' and all mechanism, outcome and study design fields are set to 'cannot_tell' without guessing.
